expectations.name: opens-with-counts
expected_behavior: States the three counts and stops, letting the user pick a list
Lists `deferred` first
Starts no grilling and drafts no page before the user picks
No preamble; each count stated once

expectations.name: never-closes-an-unknown-by-guessing
expected_behavior: Leaves the row under `## Open` with its kind and hit count unchanged, and puts the corpus hit in front of the user naming what it does and does not settle
Establishes the row's state from the user, not from the corpus
Confirms it is still open and moves on, closing it only if the user reports that a decision was actually taken

expectations.name: reclassifies-rather-than-skipping
expected_behavior: Has `srd:kb` change the row's kind from `deferred` to `unknown` in place, and says so
Writes nothing under the `kb` folder itself, and the reply names `srd:kb` as the writer for each change
Does not treat it as a skip or leave the row mislabeled
Does not file it as a documentation gap: it says nothing about the user manual

expectations.name: clusters-gaps-and-drafts-outside-the-corpus
expected_behavior: Clusters the two duplicates and surfaces the cluster size as priority
Checks the corpus before drafting, separating content that is absent from content that is present but unranked
Writes the draft outside every corpus source, the `kb` folder included
Publishes nothing itself; once given the published URL it resolves every gap in the cluster

expectations.name: gate-stops-when-the-server-fails
expected_behavior: Stops before any list is opened or counted, naming the failed `search` call and its error
Tells the user to start the `srd-doc` server and run `/mcp` to connect, then re-run
Does not work `deferred` or `unknowns` around the failure — the reply carries no counts or list and `_open-questions.md` is unchanged — and neither retries nor offers or describes a REST fallback

expectations.name: terse-output
expected_behavior: No narration of the list calls or the row moves

States what closed exactly once in the whole sitting, in the closing line — not again as each list finishes, and not restated in a second shape in the same turn. A per-delegate line counting `srd:kb`'s writes is not a restatement
No closing summary repeating the rows, and no drafted page echoed back into chat
